# Extractor stdin

The document an extractor receives on stdin. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/extractor-request/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/extractor-request/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/extractor-request/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocolVersion` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `projection` | object | Yes |  |
| `projection.id` | [`identifier`](definition.md#identifier) | Yes |  |
| `projection.definition` | [Projection definition](definition.md) | Yes |  |
| `repository` | object | Yes |  |
| `repository.mode` | `"in-place"` or `"workspace"` or `"materialized"` or `"git-objects"` | Yes | How the revision is given: the user's checkout read in place, a reused workspace, a temporary materialization, or Git objects with nothing on disk. |
| `repository.root` | string |  | The directory holding the examined revision. Absent in `git-objects` mode. At least 1 character. |
| `repository.git` | object |  | In `git-objects` mode: the Git directory and the examined tree. |
| `repository.git.directory` | string | Yes | At least 1 character. |
| `repository.git.tree` | string | Yes | Pattern `^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}\|[0-9a-f]{64})$`. |
| `repository.revision` | [`revision`](extraction-document.md#revision) | Yes |  |
| `repository.project` | string |  | The definition's project: the directory holding its `.github/projections` or `.projections`, relative to `root` (and to the Git tree in `git-objects` mode), `/`-separated; empty for the repository's root. The definition's paths and inputs are relative to it, and the extractor runs there. Absent means the root. Pattern `^(?:[^/.\\][^/\\]*\|\.[^/.\\][^/\\]*\|\.\.[^/\\]+)(?:/(?:[^/.\\][^/\\]*\|\.[^/.\\][^/\\]*\|\.\.[^/\\]+))*$\|^$`. At most 1024 characters. |
| `repository.checkout` | string |  | Where the repository's dependencies (such as `node_modules`) are installed for this run: the root itself in place or in a prepared workspace, or the user's checkout when a materialized revision borrows them; a nested project's are in its `project` directory there. Absent under container isolation and in `git-objects` mode. At least 1 character. |
| `repository.scope` | array of string |  | The enforced scope, repository-relative (the definition's own, resolved from its project): files outside it are not listed and reads fail. |
| `capabilities` | object | Yes |  |
| `capabilities.trusted` | boolean | Yes |  |
| `capabilities.network` | boolean | Yes |  |
| `upstream` | map of [Extraction](extraction.md) |  | The normalized extractions of the definition's `extractor.upstream` built-ins, keyed by the names the definition gives them. Present only when it declares some. |
| `generations` | object |  | Earlier generated values to reuse for an equal basis. Absent when the store is empty or the run regenerates. |
| `generations.file` | string | Yes | A read-only JSON Lines snapshot of the generation store: one `{"path", "basis", "value"}` per line, keyed by a generated declaration's `path` and its basis digest. At least 1 character. |

No other properties are allowed.
